releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.notes: Two versions of work are rolled up here (v1.2.0 and v1.3.0). ## Better agent discovery and chain safety - New `scripts/discover-agents.mjs`: a read-only, zero-dependency CLI that lists your custom agents (slim and native sources) and flags risky fallback chains — duplicate model ids, chains outside 2–4 entries, non-Go fallback ids not confirmed in the local registry, and vision lanes whose model is not marked vision-verified. It prints compact JSON instead of making you read config files by hand. - New `scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs`: a compact digest of the cached model snapshot (~97% shorter than the raw file), with `--ids`, `--trait`, and `--json`. ## Clearer recommendations - The recommendation table now includes a **role overview** column: a one-line, plain-language description of wha…

en.headline: 22 commits across 3 repos; opencode-go-model-picker v1.3.0 released
en.summary: On 2026-10-04, sogeisetsu made 22 commits across three repositories with no pull requests, issues, or reviews. In meld-deepresearch (11 commits), work centered on evaluation documentation and landing-page fixes: adding live Q2 comparison results across three skills, establishing a deep research evaluation standard, incorporating landing-page feedback, and cleaning up local worktree ignore blocks and stray spaces in the zh README. In sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu (8 commits), the focus was on improving the daily report tooling: switching commit counting to commit-date basis with separate own/automated tracking, adding status-change badges with UTC+8 timestamps, preserving actor casing in status badges, adding a --rerender flag, introducing a GitHub homepage button, changing the 30-day card refresh to every 2 hours, and hardening AI output with fallback to the previous narrative on failure. In opencode-go-model-picker (3 commits), the user merged the feat/skill-remediation branch, documented vision verification and the Windows refresh path, and added agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts. The v1.3.0 release for opencode-go-model-picker was published, rolling up v1.2.0 and v1.3.0 work including the new discover-agents.mjs CLI for listing custom agents and flagging risky fallback chains, the snapshot-summary.mjs digest tool, and a role-overview column in the recommendation table.

releaseNotes.summary: Rolls up v1.2.0 and v1.3.0 work. Adds discover-agents.mjs (read-only CLI listing custom agents and flagging risky fallback chains) and snapshot-summary.mjs (compact model snapshot digest). Recommendation table gains a role-overview column.

zh.headline: 3 个仓库共 22 次提交；opencode-go-model-picker 发布 v1.3.0
zh.summary: 2026-10-04，sogeisetsu 在三个仓库共提交 22 次，无 PR、issue 或 review。meld-deepresearch（11 次提交）主要围绕评估文档与落地页修复：添加三项技能的 Q2 实测对比结果、建立深度研究评估标准、落实落地页反馈、清理本地 worktree ignore 块及中文 README 多余空格。sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu（8 次提交）聚焦日报工具改进：提交统计改为按 commit date 并区分本人/机器人、新增状态变更徽章与 UTC+8 时间、保留 actor 原始大小写、新增 --rerender 参数、添加 GitHub 主页按钮、30 天卡片改为每 2 小时刷新、AI 输出加固并在失败时保留上次叙述。opencode-go-model-picker（3 次提交）合并了 feat/skill-remediation 分支，记录了视觉验证与 Windows 刷新路径，并新增 agent-discovery 和 snapshot-summary 脚本。opencode-go-model-picker 发布了 v1.3.0，合并了 v1.2.0 与 v1.3.0 的工作，包括新增 discover-agents.mjs（只读 CLI，列出自定义 agent 并标记风险回退链）、snapshot-summary.mjs（模型快照摘要工具）以及推荐表格中的角色概览列。

releaseNotes.summary: 合并了 v1.2.0 与 v1.3.0 的工作。新增 discover-agents.mjs（只读 CLI，列出自定义 agent 并标记风险回退链）和 snapshot-summary.mjs（模型快照摘要工具）。推荐表格新增角色概览列。
